decisions.title: Split the hero asymmetric
decisions.intent: Buy attention with a primary object the reader can inspect, instead of a centered sentence they have to believe.

decisions.title: Reject the equal card row
decisions.intent: Force a ranking of claims so the strongest one gets the most space and the most evidence.

decisions.title: Cite the number or drop the claim
decisions.intent: Make every quantified claim verifiable and delete the claims that only assert enthusiasm.

decisions.title: One accent, one primary action
decisions.intent: Make the next step unambiguous by spending colour and emphasis on exactly one thing.

decisions.title: Answer the objection before the ask
decisions.intent: Remove the last reason to hesitate at the moment the reader decides, not three sections later.

decisions.title: Use one language and named entities
decisions.intent: Keep credibility and mechanical cleanliness by removing stock names and mixed languages from shipped copy.

decisions.title: Use a master detail rail for repeat visits
decisions.intent: Let a returning user reach any object in one click without losing their place.

decisions.title: Reject the decorative bento grid
decisions.intent: Keep the grid only when the content is truly heterogeneous, because otherwise the page has no argument left to make with layout.

decisions.title: Compare in a matrix, not in cards
decisions.intent: Let the user compare many objects across shared attributes in one pass.

decisions.title: Label every control, never the placeholder
decisions.intent: Keep the field's purpose visible after the user has typed into it.

decisions.title: Show scope, never ask for scrolling
decisions.intent: Tell the user where they are and how far the surface goes, instead of instructing them to move.

decisions.title: Keep the app bar to one short line
decisions.intent: Protect working height and keep the primary surface reachable without a scroll.

decisions.title: Read in one measured column
decisions.intent: Let a reader finish a passage without tracking back to the start of the line.

decisions.title: Annotate in a narrow margin rail
decisions.intent: Give definitions, sources, and asides a home without breaking the reading line.

decisions.title: Open with contents, not with eyebrows
decisions.intent: Let the reader choose a section instead of walking a fixed sequence of labels.

decisions.title: Ship text without decorative chrome
decisions.intent: Keep attention on the argument by removing everything that is not the argument.

decisions.title: Choose a reading typeface, do not inherit one
decisions.intent: Make the body type a decision with a reason rather than the first font in a starter template.

decisions.title: Sequence full bleed moments, do not alternate
decisions.intent: Tell one continuous story across screens so the page reads as a single arc.

decisions.title: Declare a motion budget and honour it
decisions.intent: Make motion an amount stated before the build and checked afterwards, not a taste improvised during it.

decisions.title: Animate on entry, never on scroll position
decisions.intent: Pay for motion once when a section arrives instead of paying on every scroll frame.

decisions.title: Build depth with scale and spacing, not glow
decisions.intent: Get separation from size, weight, and space so the page holds up on any background and in both colour modes.

decisions.title: Show real media or show nothing
decisions.intent: Keep the page's credibility by never staging a product screen the product cannot produce.

decisions.title: Lock every surface value to a token
decisions.intent: Make the palette and geometry an enumerable set so an undeclared value is detectable rather than debatable.

decisions.title: Set the viewport unit and the contrast floor first
decisions.intent: Fix the two measurable properties that decide whether the page is usable before any layout work starts.
